scene.note: A clear view of a stream channel flowing through grassy pastures with a sluice gate structure.

findings.question: channel_form
findings.evidence: downstream photo, center: the channel displays sloping earthen sides forming a rounded U-shaped cross section

findings.question: bottom_type
findings.evidence: downstream photo, channel center: the channel bed is concealed beneath reflective and turbid water

findings.question: bank_type
findings.evidence: downstream photo, along both banks: the channel margins consist of natural earth and grass

findings.question: habitats
findings.evidence: downstream photo, water channel: no sand banks, islands, stone piles, riffles, or emergent aquatic plants are discernible in the water

findings.question: natural_debris
findings.evidence: downstream photo, water surface and banks: no fallen trees, branches, or leaf packs are visible

findings.question: water_flow
findings.evidence: downstream photo, water surface: the still photo does not distinguish whether the smooth water is slowly moving or stagnant

findings.question: water_aspect
findings.evidence: downstream photo, water surface: the water is brown and opaque, preventing visibility into the bed

findings.question: water_withdrawal
findings.evidence: downstream photo, channel and banks: no water intake pipes, pumps, or diversion channels are present

findings.question: barriers
findings.evidence: downstream photo, middle ground: an artificial sluice gate structure crosses the stream channel

findings.question: draining_pipes
findings.evidence: downstream photo, banks: no draining pipes discharging polluted effluent are visible

findings.question: sewage_discharge
findings.evidence: downstream photo, visible water: no sewage entry, discharge, or wastewater plumes are visible

findings.question: construction
findings.evidence: downstream photo, channel area: no construction machinery, works, or fresh building materials are present

findings.question: impervious_left
findings.evidence: downstream photo, left margin: the area consists entirely of vegetated ground and earthen bank without paved surfaces

findings.question: impervious_right
findings.evidence: downstream photo, right margin: the ground is open grassy field and pasture with no impervious coverage

findings.question: vegetation_left
findings.evidence: downstream photo, left margin: the ground is covered by grasses, shrubs, and trees

findings.question: vegetation_type_left
findings.evidence: downstream photo, left margin bank top: grasses and herbaceous plants dominate the immediate bank area

findings.question: vegetation_right
findings.evidence: downstream photo, right margin: continuous grass cover extends along the bank

findings.question: vegetation_type_right
findings.evidence: downstream photo, right margin: the bank top and adjacent field are dominated by grass and herbaceous vegetation

findings.question: vegetation_cut
findings.evidence: downstream photo, along the banks: no fresh cuts, cleared banks, or mown strips are visible on the stream banks
